The girls and women will also have a bonus Pin Up image each (this gallery will also feature remakes of the in-game monster's portraits as a bonus, and new illustrations depicting the monsters and the important NPCs)

In most of the Fire Emblem games since Fire Emblem 6 (2001, GBA), the "Support System" is available as a way to explore more the depth of each playable character through the interaction between other few, selected characters.

This gallery is going to offer Illustrated Reiterpretations of every support between the characters from Fire Emblem: 8 The Sacred Stones (2004) and also artworks featuring both the monsters both the important NPC toget.her

the following FE entries (only 1 between the C,B,A support levels) will be also featured in future correspective gallery each, and I will add a link for each entry:

Supports will be in order of characters and entry.
